category: アプリ開発、デプロイ、デバッグ
title: Retrying Partial Batches
prompt: An SQS standard queue is configured as an event source for Lambda. What should you configure to retry only the messages whose processing failed?

choices.explanation: This does not report the success or failure of individual items, and it can increase duplicates if it is shorter than the processing time.

choices.text: Enable ReportBatchItemFailures and return the IDs of failed messages
choices.explanation: This enables Lambda to identify the individual items that failed.

choices.text: Throw an unhandled exception for one failed item
choices.explanation: The entire batch is treated as failed.

learning.reason: This enables Lambda to identify the individual items that failed.
learning.concept: Using partial batch responses does not make the entire SQS workflow exactly once. Design writes to be idempotent.

category: アプリ開発、デプロイ、デバッグ
title: Returning to the Previous Version
prompt: You want to send only some requests to a new Lambda version and return to the old version through a configuration change if an issue occurs. What should you use to maintain a stable invocation target?

choices.explanation: This controls concurrency; it does not change the traffic ratio between old and new versions.
This cannot represent partial routing to an old version or invocations pinned to a version.

choices.text: Publish versions and configure weighted routing for an alias
choices.explanation: An alias can manage traffic distribution between two published versions.

learning.reason: An alias can manage traffic distribution between two published versions.
learning.concept: When used with CodeDeploy, aliases can automate canary deployments and alarm-based rollbacks.

category: アプリ開発、デプロイ、デバッグ
title: Conditional Registration
prompt: The same order ID can be registered concurrently. What should you use to allow only the first request without overwriting an existing item?

choices.text: Run a strongly consistent Scan first
choices.explanation: Even if the read returns the latest state, it does not prevent a race with a subsequent write.

choices.text: Set an attribute_not_exists condition on PutItem
choices.explanation: The condition check and write occur in one operation.

choices.text: Use GetItem to check for existence, then perform an unconditional PutItem
choices.explanation: Another process can register the item between the check and the write.

learning.reason: The condition check and write occur in one operation.
learning.concept: Evaluating the condition that preserves uniqueness on the data store's write side avoids relying on application-side prechecks.

category: アプリ開発、デプロイ、デバッグ
title: Direct Uploads from a Browser
prompt: You want authenticated users to upload directly to one authorized S3 key for only 10 minutes. What should you use to accomplish this without distributing long-term credentials?

choices.text: Allow everyone to use PutObject in a bucket policy
choices.explanation: This configuration would allow unauthenticated users and operations on other keys as well.

choices.text: Have the backend issue a presigned PUT URL for the specified key
choices.explanation: This delegates the specified operation for a limited time.

choices.text: Change only the S3 CORS rules
choices.explanation: This handles browser origin restrictions, not authorization for the S3 API.

learning.reason: This delegates the specified operation for a limited time.
learning.concept: A presigned URL can be used by someone else if it is shared while valid. Restrict the issuer, key, and expiration.

category: アプリ開発、デプロイ、デバッグ
title: SDK permissions
prompt: A Fargate container uses the AWS SDK to write to DynamoDB. Image retrieval at container startup has already succeeded. What should you change?

choices.explanation: This controls access to the image, but does not grant permission to write to DynamoDB.

choices.text: Change only the task execution role
choices.explanation: This is primarily for startup preparation by the ECS agent; it does not grant permissions to the application inside the task.

choices.text: Add DynamoDB permissions to the application's task role
choices.explanation: This controls the credentials available to the application running in the task.

learning.reason: This controls the credentials available to the application running in the task.
learning.concept: Separate the permissions used to start a task from those used by the application after startup.

category: アプリ開発、デプロイ、デバッグ
title: Retrying operations and duplicate charges
prompt: A payment API may lose its connection immediately after a successful response. How can you avoid charging the same order twice when retrying?

choices.text: Assign a new idempotency key to every request
choices.explanation: The payment service will see each request as a separate operation.

choices.text: Delete the SQS message before calling the payment service
choices.explanation: This may reduce duplicate processing, but if the call fails, the business operation itself is lost.

choices.text: Reuse the same idempotency key for each retry of an order
choices.explanation: The payment service can recognize the requests as the same operation.

learning.reason: The payment service can recognize the requests as the same operation.
learning.concept: A timeout from an external API does not confirm failure. Preserve request identity when retrying.
